_about: Multi-agent scenarios for Local Agent Lab: nodes (see src/local_llm/lab/nodes.py for types and params) and edges (START/END, optional 'when' for router options). Edited in the UI or by the control-center coding agent; every change is versioned in storage/lab/history.

name.zh: 公司問答路由（nimble 分派）

description.zh: 決策模型 nimble 先判斷問題屬於哪個部門，再交給對應的資料庫 agent；不需要公司資料的問題交給一般 LLM。
description.en: The nimble decision model picks the department first, then the matching database agent answers; questions that need no company data go to a plain LLM.

zh: nimble 約 2–3 秒做出決定並給出各選項機率
部門 agent 只能用自己的資料庫權限
en: nimble decides in ~2–3 s and shows a probability per option
Each department agent only has its own database permissions

zh: 2026 年營收最高的前三個城市是哪些？
各部門的在職人數與平均月薪
目前還沒解決的緊急工單有幾張？
幫我寫一段歡迎新同事的話
en: Which three cities had the highest revenue in 2026?
Headcount and average salary per department
How many urgent tickets are still open?
Write a short welcome note for a new colleague

params.instructions: Which department's assistant should answer this question about the company?

options.sales: Sales data: customers, orders, revenue, products, prices, inventory
options.hr: HR data: employees, departments, salaries, leave, attendance
options.support: Customer support data: tickets, returns, quality issues
options.general: No company data needed: writing, translation, general knowledge

params.system: You are a friendly assistant at 示範精密工業. Answer in the language of the user's question; for Chinese use Traditional Chinese (Taiwan).

description.zh: 關鍵字與向量檢索平行執行，用 RRF 融合排名，再用 cross-encoder 重新排序，最後由 LLM 引用出處回答。
description.en: Keyword and vector search run in parallel, RRF fuses the rankings, a cross-encoder reranks, and the LLM answers with citations.

zh: BM25 抓精確詞（產品代號、數字），向量抓語意（含英文問中文文件）
Rerank 前後排名都看得到
試試範例第 1 題：融合後第 1 名是錯的段落，Rerank 才把正確段落排上來（看「每一步」裡的 Rerank 表）
en: BM25 catches exact terms (product codes, numbers); vectors catch meaning (even English questions over Chinese docs)
See rankings before and after reranking
Try the first examples: fusion ranks a wrong passage first and the reranker fixes it (see the Rerank table under Steps)

zh: 員工可以把客戶合約貼到 ChatGPT 嗎？
特休沒休完可以遞延到什麼時候？
去日本出差每天的日支費是多少？
伺服馬達過熱該怎麼處理？
en: How fast must we answer when a customer's line stops?
What discount can a junior sales rep give?
Until when can unused annual leave be carried over?
What is the daily allowance for a business trip to Japan?
What should I do if a servo motor overheats?

params.system: You answer questions about the internal rules of 示範精密工業 (a fictional Taiwanese precision-parts maker) using only the numbered passages. Cite them as [n]. If the passages do not contain the answer, say so. Answer in the language of the user's question; for Chinese use Traditional Chinese (Taiwan).

name.zh: 自我檢查 RAG（改寫→檢索→回答→依據檢查）
name.en: Self-checking RAG (rewrite → retrieve → answer → grounding check)

description.zh: 先把問題改寫成檢索用語，回答後再由 nimble 檢查答案是否都有文件依據；沒依據就改走保守回覆。
description.en: The question is rewritten for search; after answering, nimble checks that every claim is backed by the passages, otherwise a cautious fallback reply is written.

zh: 條件分支：通過檢查 / 改寫保守回覆
問文件裡沒有的事（例如健身房補助）會走保守回覆
en: Conditional branch: grounded vs. cautious fallback
Ask something the documents don't cover (e.g. a gym subsidy) to see the fallback

zh: SM-400 的交期是多久？為什麼？
國外出差什麼情況可以搭豪華經濟艙？
公司有沒有提供健身房補助？
en: How long is the lead time for the SM-400, and why?
When may I fly premium economy on an overseas trip?
Does the company subsidize gym memberships?

params.prompt:
Rewrite the question as a short search query in Traditional Chinese containing the key terms (keep product codes and numbers). Output only the query.

Question: {question}

params.system: You answer questions about the internal rules of 示範精密工業 (a fictional Taiwanese precision-parts maker) using only the numbered passages. Cite them as [n]. If the passages do not contain the answer, say so. Answer in the language of the user's question; for Chinese use Traditional Chinese (Taiwan).

params.instructions: Is every factual claim in the answer supported by the passages, and do the passages actually answer the question?

options.grounded: Yes: the answer is fully supported by the passages
options.not_grounded: No: the answer has unsupported claims or the passages do not answer the question

description.zh: 依提問者的部門過濾可檢索的文件：同一個問題，人資部查得到薪資制度，業務部查不到。
description.en: Retrieval is filtered by the asker's department: the same question finds the pay policy for HR but not for Sales.

zh: 權限在檢索階段就過濾，機密段落不會進到 prompt
試試：以業務部與人資部各問一次「P3 職等月薪範圍」
en: Filtering happens at retrieval, so restricted passages never reach the prompt
Try 'P3 grade salary range' as Sales and then as HR

zh: P3 職等的月薪範圍是多少？
業務經理最多可以給多少折扣？
品質異常什麼時候要啟動 8D？
en: What is the monthly salary range for grade P3?
What is the maximum discount a sales manager may give?
When must an 8D be started for a quality issue?

params.system: You answer questions about the internal rules of 示範精密工業 (a fictional Taiwanese precision-parts maker) using only the numbered passages. Cite them as [n]. If the passages do not contain the answer, say so. Answer in the language of the user's question; for Chinese use Traditional Chinese (Taiwan). You serve the {department} department; if the passages do not cover the question, say that the documents available to this department do not include it.

name.zh: 會議錄音 → 會議紀錄

description.zh: 說話者分段模型找出誰在什麼時候說話，Breeze-ASR-25 把台灣華語錄音轉成標上講者的逐字稿，兩個 LLM 平行產生摘要與待辦事項（標明由哪位講者提出），再組成會議紀錄。
description.en: A diarization model finds who spoke when, Breeze-ASR-25 turns the Taiwanese-Mandarin audio into a speaker-labelled transcript, and two LLMs write the summary and the action items (with who raised them) in parallel before the minutes are assembled.

zh: 非 Ollama 模型（說話者分段、語音辨識）與 Ollama LLM 串在同一條流程
逐字稿標上「講者 1／講者 2」，待辦事項可以對到人
摘要與待辦平行執行
en: Non-Ollama models (diarization, speech recognition) chained with Ollama LLMs
The transcript is labelled Speaker 1 / Speaker 2, so action items can name who raised them
Summary and action items run in parallel

name.zh: 合約審閱（Docling 解析＋雙 LLM）

description.zh: Docling 把 PDF 合約（含表格）轉成 Markdown，一個 LLM 抽出關鍵條款，另一個從買方角度找出風險條款。
description.en: Docling turns the PDF contract (tables included) into Markdown; one LLM extracts the key terms while another flags risky clauses for the buyer.

zh: 表格解析品質直接影響抽取結果
兩個審閱角度平行執行
en: Table parsing quality drives extraction quality
Two review angles run in parallel

name.zh: 客服工單分流＋回覆草稿

description.zh: nimble 一次判斷負責團隊、緊急程度、是否要求退款；同時檢索客服 SOP；LLM 草擬回覆後由「主管」LLM 依 SOP 校稿。
description.en: nimble answers three questions at once (team, urgency, refund request) while the support SOP is retrieved; one LLM drafts the reply and a 'team lead' LLM checks it against the SOP.

zh: 分類與檢索平行執行，草稿等兩邊都完成
兩階段 LLM：草擬 → 審核
en: Classification and retrieval run in parallel; the draft waits for both
Two LLM stages: draft → review

zh: 你們上個月出的 SM-400 伺服馬達有 3 台開機就跳 Err-21，我們產線已經停了，請盡快處理，不行的話要退貨退款。
請問 LG20 線性滑軌多久要上一次油？
發票抬頭開錯了，麻煩重新開立。
en: Three SM-400 servo motors from last month throw Err-21 at start-up and our line is down. Please fix this urgently, otherwise we want a return and refund.
How often should the LG20 linear guide be lubricated?
The company name on our invoice is wrong, please reissue it.

team.instructions: Which team should handle this ticket?

urgency.instructions: How urgent is this ticket for the customer?

refund.instructions: Does the customer ask for a refund or a return?

description.zh: 三個不同的地端模型（Qwen3 30B、台灣 TAIDE 12B、Qwen3 1.7B）平行回答，再由彙整者綜合成最佳答案。
description.en: Three different local models (Qwen3 30B, Taiwan's TAIDE 12B, Qwen3 1.7B) answer in parallel; an aggregator merges them into the best answer.

zh: 同時載入三個模型（OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=3）
時間軸可看出三個模型的速度差異
en: Three models loaded at once (OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=3)
The timeline shows the speed of each model

zh: 用三句話向國中生解釋什麼是地端 AI
台灣的半導體產業為什麼重要？
幫我想 3 個公司內部 AI 導入活動的標語
en: Explain on-prem AI to a 13-year-old in three sentences
Why does Taiwan's semiconductor industry matter?
Suggest 3 slogans for an internal AI adoption campaign

params.system: Answer in the language of the user's question; for Chinese use Traditional Chinese (Taiwan).
Answer in the language of the user's question; for Chinese use Traditional Chinese (Taiwan).
Answer in the language of the user's question; for Chinese use Traditional Chinese (Taiwan).

name.zh: 業務週報（分析 agent → 撰寫 → 翻譯）

description.zh: 業務部 agent 查資料庫取得數字，撰寫者整理成主管備忘錄，翻譯者產出英文版。
description.en: The sales agent pulls numbers from the database, a writer turns them into a management memo, and a translator produces the English version.

zh: 工具呼叫 agent 與一般 LLM 串成流水線
撰寫者被要求不得捏造數字
en: A tool-calling agent chained with plain LLMs
The writer is told never to invent numbers

zh: 2026 年各城市營收前五名
目前低於安全存量的產品與倉庫
en: Top five cities by revenue in 2026
Products below safety stock, by warehouse

params.prompt:
Translate this memo into natural business English. Keep the Markdown structure, tables and numbers. Output only the translation.

{memo_zh}

description.zh: 同一段錄音平行交給四個語音辨識模型（Breeze-ASR-25、Whisper、Qwen3-ASR、Gemma 4 音訊 LLM），各自對照原稿算出字錯率（CER），再由 LLM 比較錯誤類型並推薦模型。每個節點的模型都可以在左側換掉。
description.en: One recording goes to four speech-recognition models in parallel (Breeze-ASR-25, Whisper, Qwen3-ASR and the Gemma 4 audio LLM); each is scored against the reference transcript (character error rate, CER), then an LLM compares their error types and recommends one. Each node's model can be swapped on the left.

zh: 四個語音模型平行執行：三個在模型閘道（MLX，輪流用 GPU）、Gemma 4 在 Ollama
兩段範例：總統國慶演說（真人、照稿）與虛構會議（合成語音），原稿自動填入，可對照評分
依序執行、含即時倍率與逐字差異標示的比較，請用「模型比較 → 語音辨識模型」
en: Four speech models in parallel: three in the model gateway (MLX, taking turns on the GPU) and Gemma 4 in Ollama
Two samples, a real read-from-script speech and a synthetic meeting; their scripts fill in the reference automatically
For a sequential run with real-time factors and highlighted differences, use Compare models → Speech recognition

label.zh: 真人：總統國慶演說節錄（4 分 29 秒，照稿宣讀）〔總統府提供〕
label.en: Real voice: President's National Day address, excerpt (4 min 29 s, read from script; courtesy of the Office of the President)

label.zh: 合成語音：虛構產銷會議（88 秒，兩位講者）
label.en: Synthetic voices: fictional production meeting (88 s, two speakers)

label.zh: 參考原稿（範例錄音的原稿會自動填入；上傳的錄音沒有原稿請填「無」）
label.en: Reference transcript (filled in for the samples; write 'none' for an upload without one)

zh: 無
en: none
